flows.narrative: The week-ending-Nov-4 Lipper cut (the first to capture the midterm-relief rally and most of Wednesday's session, but NOT Thursday Nov 5's AI-capex-driven reversal, which falls in the following week not yet published) showed a 7th straight week of global equity inflows (+$38.63B, largest since Sept 23) alongside a record $117.97B flood into US money-market funds -- a barbell of still-buying-stocks-but-raising-cash that reads as hedging into the midterm/AI-capex uncertainty rather than a clean risk-on or risk-off signal. Gold ETFs logged a 4th straight monthly inflow in October per the World Gold Council, Europe- and Asia-led, with North America the only outflow region.
